required_per_card_recipe_fields: dataset or corpus name and version
actual rows or batches, tokens, sequence/context, features, classes and vocabulary
model architecture and every estimator/optimizer setting
seed and shuffled order or counter mapping
intrinsic cap audit and expected full coverage
A/B compiler defines and runtime environment
source, compiler, binary and harness provenance
predeclared task quality metric and tolerance
known_pending_coverage: Per-card exact full-data recipes, content hashes and dimensions have not been collected in this source-only task.
The neural driver documents a sequence cap for CPU lanes; full selectors alone are insufficient.
Standalone GEMM, norm, attention, optimizer or convolution timing does not qualify dependent full neural estimators.
Full backward, decode, checkpoint/recovery and MoE training recipes require explicit mapping where absent.
The existing recurrent persistent-scan source records failed quality and remains unqualified.
Every version-changing candidate needs all-column contract implementation and quality evidence before promotion.

saved_recipe_notes_not_run_provenance.cnn_clf: tools/bench_board_algos.py declares seeded synthetic images, 20000 fit and 5000 held out, 2 epochs; no image set is in that driver's R2 store. Use the full declared workload, not a smaller caller fixture.
saved_recipe_notes_not_run_provenance.recurrent: The same driver defines LSTM/GRU/RNN clf/reg on taxi-hourly and synthetic windows, T=24, hidden=64, batch=256, 2 epochs. Actual input counts, hashes and intrinsic caps must still be recorded.
saved_recipe_notes_not_run_provenance.moe: The saved MoE lane is explicitly forward-only; no public MoE backward exists in its recorded recipe. Do not claim full MoE training coverage from it.
saved_recipe_notes_not_run_provenance.graph_neural: GCN and GraphSAGE use saved graph/node features in tools/bench_board_algos.py. Default GraphSAGE is mean aggregation; NI58 max aggregation needs its own complete recipe.
saved_recipe_notes_not_run_provenance.dropout: The saved dropout2d component uses independent library RNG and does not compare their outputs. Candidate same-version identity needs exact own-arm mask/state evidence and full CNN consumer coverage.

acceptance.performance: NVIDIA and AMD combined faster, neither materially slower, all affected full workloads and relevant combinations measured.
acceptance.identity: Same-version output, gradient and observable state bits match across host/NVIDIA/AMD/Apple; A and B may differ for V arms.
acceptance.quality: No degradation under predeclared full-task gates, including held-out results, multi-step training, gradients/state and resume where applicable.
acceptance.boards: Only actual immutable evidence may be admitted through board tools; no opponent ratios invented from own-only A/B.
